instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Step 2: the successor signs to accept, so a typo can't hand the
protocol to a key nobody holds.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Pays the creator `creator_fees_owed` (the early 20%) at any time, plus
`creator_fees_locked` once the curve has graduated.

instructions.name: create_token
docs: Creates the mint, mints the whole supply to the curve, revokes the mint
authority, opens the curve and optionally performs a locked dev buy.

instructions.name: forfeit_creator_fees
docs: Permissionless. Once the curve is `CREATOR_FEE_FORFEIT_SECONDS` old and
has not graduated, moves the locked creator fees to the protocol's
`fee_recipient` and zeroes them. The early share stays claimable.

instructions.name: migrate
docs: Permissionless graduation. Once the curve has sold out, creates a
Raydium CPMM pool (token / wSOL) seeded with the raised SOL (minus the
graduation fee and Raydium's costs) and the 200M reserve tokens, then
burns every LP token so the liquidity can never be pulled.
A system-owned PDA (`pool_creator`) acts as Raydium's `creator`, because
Raydium pays rent and its fee from the creator with system transfers.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (a keeper) can graduate a sold-out curve; pays for two token accounts.

accounts.name: curve
docs: updated in load/mark helpers: deserializing it here put try_accounts over
SBF's 4 KB stack frame.

accounts.name: pool_creator
docs: System-owned PDA that acts as Raydium's pool creator.

accounts.name: creator_token
docs: the associated-token program verifies the address. Not `init_if_needed`:
that codegen pushed try_accounts past SBF's 4 KB stack frame.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Admin: fee settings (devnet uses a small graduation fee).
Admin handover, step 1: the current authority names its successor
(on mainnet, the Squads multisig vault). Nothing changes until step 2.

instructions.name: resize_curve
docs: Permissionless migration helper: grows a `Curve` created before
`creator_fees_locked` existed to the current size (the payer funds the
extra rent; new bytes are zero, so the new field reads 0). No-op if the
account is already large enough.

accounts.name: curve
docs: because an account too small for `Curve` cannot be deserialized.

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity

errors.name: CreatorFeesLocked

errors.name: NotForfeitable

fields.name: price_cumulative
docs: TWAP accumulator: sum of price_q64 * slots, wrapping.

fields.name: creator_fees_locked
docs: The 80% of creator fees held until graduation. APPENDED after `bump`:
curves created before this field existed need `resize_curve`.

types.name: PendingAuthority
docs: A proposed admin handover, waiting for the successor to accept.
